reviewed_controls: An unreaped private keeper pins the PGID; Codex is placed in that group and only that owned PGID is targeted by killpg.
A leader exit alone does not prove group quiescence; /proc scan excludes only keeper and inactive zombie/exiting members, with unknown scan treated as no success.
TERM grace is 1.25 seconds followed by KILL and a 0.45 second verification window; the 45 second child wait remains, local 49 second cap remains.
Terminal success requires child exit 0, group quiescent, scratch cleaned, EOF, and SSH exit 0.
No raw stdout/stderr/account data are printed or persisted by intended receipt path.
App-server argv omits --stdio per pinned source default stated in review.md.
limits: Source review and author-reported focal fixtures only; no live /proc, SSH, CLI, RPC, auth or network verification.
A descendant that deliberately leaves the owned process group/session is outside this containment; documented in review.md.
Pinned source claim for app-server default was accepted from review.md and not independently browsed in this pass.
